recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not recreate the old Observation-genetics Haplotype profile in FHIR core unless Clinical Genomics reopens the scope and decides to move this profile back from the Genomics Reporting IG.
issue_request: FHIR-14316 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked for a Haplotype profile under Observation-genetics with derivedFrom links to variant profiles, LOINC 84414-2, value content, gene-studied component 48018-6, and GenomicLocation component grouping; the accepted resolution says this was already applied as the Haplotype profile in the Genomics Reporting IG.
initial_application: No current FHIR-core commit explicitly applies FHIR-14316 as a core profile. Historical core source contained Observation genomics artifacts and haplotype examples, but commit 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435 removed the outdated clinical genomics artifacts and redirected core guidance toward the Genomics Reporting IG.
additional_context: The active core profile list in source/fhir.ini does not include Observation-genetics or Haplotype, while Observation notes and the genomics page link implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG. The published Genomics Reporting IG has an active Haplotype profile with canonical http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/genomics-reporting/StructureDefinition/haplotype and constraints matching the main requested concepts. CG minutes record the same external-IG disposition.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The required reconciliation is an empty audit commit marking the issue as external-repo because the profile belongs to, and exists in, the Genomics Reporting IG.
